summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser in rdflib/extras/shacl.py (SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path) and added tests in test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py. Both the new tests and the existing test/test_path.py pass (42 passed) using the shared venv Python. Nothing was committed. Not verified: mypy, ruff and black are not installed in the shared venv, so the type-check gate and formatter were not run; line lengths were checked by hand (all within 88). The type-ignore comments on modifier-on-IRI lines follow the spec but are unconfirmed by a checker. In the tests, sh:path lookups are narrowed with an assert rather than type-ignore comments.
